svg.title: Production RAG platform architecture on AWS EKS
svg.desc: Two flows. A query path where a user request passes through the load balancer, identity provider, RAG API, a permission filter, the vector store and the model gateway. And an ingestion path where documents move from object storage through a queue to workers that write into the same vector store.
svg.text: only from what they may see
The same container images run locally under docker compose against the same Qdrant image.
Only the config differs. That is what keeps the development loop fast and the cluster bill small.
